### Problem

The daily drift check ("Repositories in step") finds every repository whose workflow callers fell behind the templates, but nothing brings them in step: someone has to run `sync-repos.py callers` by hand. Until then, features the engine at v7 already has do not work there. On 2026-11-06, 17 repositories had an `issues.yml` without `/claim`, without the answers in issue comments and without the "what waits on whom" board, while all of them called `@v7`.

### Scope

The daily drift check runs the `callers` sync for each repository it finds behind, from the merged main, so its issues and pull requests take the `org-sync` lane (accepted by the policy, merged with no person once green), and it does not open a second pull request for a repository that already has an open one.

### Out of scope

What `callers` writes (#671, the placeholder bug, which must be fixed first: this issue depends on it). Labels, settings, Dependabot and the other drift the check reports.

### Acceptance criteria

C1: Given a repository whose `issues.yml` lacks a job of its template, when the daily drift check runs, then it opens one org-sync issue and pull request for that repository with the update.
C2: Given a repository that already has an open org-sync callers pull request, when the drift check runs again, then it opens none.
C3: Given every repository in step, when the drift check runs, then it opens nothing.

### Criticality

Normal
